text: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity. Battery storage lets households use solar power at night.

Our team migrated the payments service to Kubernetes. Deployments now roll out automatically through CI pipelines.

The museum opened a new gallery for modern sculpture. Visitors can book guided tours online.
Credit card fraud detection relies on anomaly detection models. Flagged transactions are reviewed by analysts.
The football club signed a new striker before the season. Fans expect the team to challenge for the title.
Gradient boosting often outperforms linear models on tabular data. Feature engineering still matters a lot.
City councils are debating new rules for electric scooters. Operators must share trip data with planners.
Students at the university built a robot that sorts recycling. The project won a regional engineering prize.
Remote work changed how companies hire engineers. Video interviews now replace many onsite rounds.
